terms: This is a business-to-business service for the company named on the sample page.
You pay a one-off setup fee now and a monthly fee from today, billed monthly by card through Stripe.
We build your site from the details you send us. Nothing goes live until you have seen it and we have checked it.
Cancel any time from the link in your receipt or by replying to any email from us; the site comes down at the end of the month you've paid for.
If we haven't started work, you can cancel within 14 days for a full refund of the setup fee.
Your own domain name, if you want one, is a separate proposal we send you after launch.
